_metadata.description: Aggregation-Operator (AO) conflict-detection pairs -- Group A3. Each pair has identical tables, identical columns, and identical filter-logic operator topology (so D3 and D4 cannot distinguish them by construction); they differ only in aggregation_fn. This dataset exists specifically to (a) demonstrate the aggregation-operator blind spot D4 has and D5 closes, and (b) give A4's full evaluation matrix a category where D4 and D5 provably diverge, which is what the paired McNemar test in run_a4_full_matrix.py compares.
_metadata.labeling_methodology: Single-pass, single-labeler (the executing agent for this build pass -- see extension_paper/docs/limitations.md). Each pair's ground-truth is_conflict label and rationale were authored together, by construction of the pair (i.e. the pairs were built to have a known, intended answer, not labeled after the fact from an ambiguous real query pair). No second labeler or inter-rater agreement statistic exists for this dataset; treat P/R/F1 on this category as a demonstration of the mechanism against clearly-intended cases, not as an estimate of real-world AO-conflict detection accuracy on ambiguous queries.
_metadata.created_for: extension_paper Group A3 (see build_prompt.md Section 3, Group A)

pairs.name: revenue: SUM vs AVG over identical join/filter
pairs.rationale: Same tables, columns, and filter window; total revenue (SUM) and average order value (AVG) are genuinely different metrics that would silently diverge if cached under the same metric_name.

pairs.name: order_count: COUNT vs SUM(quantity) over identical scope
pairs.rationale: Number of orders (COUNT) vs total units ordered (SUM of quantity) over the same scope are different business quantities despite identical lineage and filter.

pairs.name: campaign_spend: MIN vs MAX over identical scope
pairs.rationale: Minimum vs maximum campaign spend are extremes of the same distribution, not the same value -- a genuine conflict if both are cached as "campaign_spend".

pairs.name: active_customers: COUNT vs COUNT (identical, negative control)
pairs.rationale: Negative control: tables, columns, filter logic, and aggregation function are all identical -- this must not be flagged, or the detector has a false-positive problem on the trivial case.

pairs.name: support_load: avg vs AVG (case-normalization negative control)
pairs.rationale: Negative control for aggregation_fn normalization: "avg" and "AVG" must normalize to the same canonical value and not be flagged as a conflict (see amu_ext.aggregation.normalize_aggregation_fn).

pairs.name: revenue_by_region: SUM vs no-aggregation (row-level) over identical scope

a.filter_logic: revenue by region via nation lookup

b.filter_logic: revenue by region via nation lookup

pairs.rationale: A row-level (unaggregated / IDENTITY) value and its SUM over the same scope are not interchangeable -- one is per-line-item revenue, the other a regional total. aggregation_fn=null normalizes to IDENTITY, which is still distinct from SUM.

pairs.name: churn_rate: COUNT vs AVG over identical scope
pairs.rationale: Count of churned customers vs. their average transaction amount are unrelated quantities that happen to share a filter and join path -- flagging this protects against a metric_name collision, not a lineage collision.

pairs.name: high_value_segment: SUM vs SUM, threshold-only variant (should NOT flag)
pairs.rationale: Both sides sum the same column over the same join path; only the decile threshold changed (same shape as the original dataset's TV category). Combining a matching aggregation_fn with a threshold-only filter change must not be flagged -- this guards against D5 over-flagging every AO-category pair regardless of whether aggregation actually differs.

pairs.name: supplier_cost: MIN vs AVG AND an AND-to-OR filter change (double conflict)
pairs.rationale: Two independent conflict signals at once (AND-to-OR filter-topology change AND a different aggregation function) -- D4 alone already flags this via the topology diff, and D5 must continue to flag it too (D5 is a superset of D4's flagged conflicts, never a subset).

pairs.name: campaign_roi: unspecified (None/IDENTITY) vs SUM over identical scope
pairs.rationale: An unspecified/row-level aggregation (null, normalized to IDENTITY) is not the same value as an explicit SUM over the same scope -- this checks that null normalizes to a real, comparable value rather than being treated as a wildcard that matches anything.
